- Validate inputs: ensure base is an integer between 2 and 9 inclusive; handle x == 0 by returning "0". Work with absolute value for conversion and track sign if negatives should be supported.
- Perform base conversion via repeated division: loop while n > 0, append str(n % base) to a list, set n //= base; reverse the collected digits and join into a string.
- Prepend '-' if original x was negative; return the resulting string.
